sections.title: Thinning and sprinkling: from robust sampling to almost Hamiltonicity
sections.abstract: The authors develop thinning–sprinkling for robust sampling and almost-Hamiltonicity.
sections.claimed_result: Almost-spanning cycles in tough, vertex-transitive, and nearly regular expander graphs under polylogarithmic hypotheses.
sections.assumptions_and_setting: Finite graph settings with stated connectivity, toughness, degree, or expansion assumptions.
sections.caveat: Asymptotic preprint claim; full hypotheses require checking.

sections.title: Localization near the edge for the lattice Anderson-Bernoulli model on general dimension
sections.abstract: Anderson localization near the spectral edge for Bernoulli disorder in all dimensions d≥2.
sections.claimed_result: Edge localization using probabilistic discrete unique continuation.
sections.assumptions_and_setting: Lattice Anderson model with Bernoulli potential near the bottom of the spectrum.
sections.caveat: Preprint claim; proof details require full-paper review.

sections.title: Stable solutions of the Allen–Cahn equation in dimension three are one-dimensional
sections.abstract: Every bounded stable Allen–Cahn solution in R3 is claimed to be one-dimensional.
sections.claimed_result: The result implies De Giorgi’s conjecture for monotone solutions in dimension four.
sections.caveat: Abstract-level evidence only; details of the classification proof remain unchecked.

sections.title: Global well-posedness and scattering for the three-dimensional focusing energy-critical NLS
sections.abstract: Global well-posedness and scattering below ground-state energy and gradient thresholds.
sections.claimed_result: A claimed confirmation of the three-dimensional threshold conjecture.
sections.assumptions_and_setting: Focusing energy-critical NLS in three dimensions under both threshold conditions.
sections.caveat: Preprint claim; threshold and error estimates need independent verification.

sections.title: A 1/64 spectral gap for surfaces with δ=1/2
sections.abstract: An explicit essential spectral gap is proved for convex co-compact hyperbolic surfaces.
sections.claimed_result: The gap is 1/64−ε at δ=1/2, via a new fractal uncertainty principle.
sections.assumptions_and_setting: Convex co-compact hyperbolic surfaces with δ in (2/5,14/27).
sections.caveat: Sharpness and dependence on the cited Furstenberg theorem are open from the abstract.

sections.title: A Peterson program for general Schubert varieties and mirror symmetry
sections.abstract: A generalized Peterson variety and mirror-symmetric superpotential are constructed for arbitrary Schubert varieties.
sections.claimed_result: The quantum-cohomology correspondence is conjectured and verified in selected type-A cases.
sections.assumptions_and_setting: Schubert varieties in partial/full flag varieties, especially smooth Fano cases.
sections.caveat: Central identifications are conjectural beyond verified cases.

sections.title: Diophantine approximation by primes and Landau–Siegel zeros
sections.abstract: Conditional on Siegel-zero hypotheses, infinitely many primes yield explicit Diophantine approximations.
sections.claimed_result: Bounds near p^(−1/3) are obtained under two strengths of the hypothesis.
sections.assumptions_and_setting: α irrational of finite type, β real, and the stated conditional zero assumptions.
sections.caveat: The main conclusions are conditional on unresolved hypotheses.

sections.title: The Dynamical Radius of Comparison for C*-Dynamical Systems
sections.abstract: A dynamical radius of comparison is introduced for C*-dynamical systems.
sections.claimed_result: Structural properties, separating examples, and dynamical-comparison criteria are proved.
sections.assumptions_and_setting: Unital C*-algebras and group actions under varying finiteness and Rokhlin-type hypotheses.
sections.caveat: Behavior outside the listed regimes remains unclear from the abstract.
